Lancaster City Council/Redevelopment Agency
CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY/
FINANCING/POWER AUTHORITY
REGULAR MEETING
AGENDA
Tuesday
February 12, 2008
Regular Meeting -- 06:00 p.m.
Council Chambers – Lancaster City Hall
The City Clerk/Agency/Authority Secretary hereby declares the agenda was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, November 30, -1
at the entrance to the Lancaster City Hall Council Chambers
44933 Fern Avenue, Lancaster, California 93534
LEGISLATIVE BODY
City Council/Successor Agency/Financing/Power Authority
Mayor/Chairman R. Rex Parris
Vice Mayor/Vice Chair Ronald D. Smith
Council Member/Agency/Authority Member Marvin Crist
Council Member/Agency/Authority Member Sandra Johnson
Council Member/Agency/Authority Member Ken Mann
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Council Members/Agency Directors: Jeffra, Sileo, Smith; Vice Mayor/Vice Chairman Visokey; Mayor/Chairman Hearns
INVOCATION
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
1.
Career and Technical Education Month
2.
Proclamation "Go Red for Women" Day
3.
Courage and Dedication Presentation - Council Member Jim Jeffra
Los Angeles County Fire Department
4.
Code Enforcement Presentation - Housing Director, Elizabeth Brubaker
AGENDA ITEMS TO BE REMOVED
Sometimes it is necessary to remove items from the agenda. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause you.
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR - AGENDIZED ITEMS
Any person who would like to address the Redevelopment Agency/City Council on any agendized item is requested to complete a speaker card for the Secretary/City Clerk and identify the agenda item you would like to discuss.   Each person will be given an opportunity to address the Redevelopment Agency/City Council at the time such item is
discussed by the Redevelopment Agency/City Council.  Speaker cards are available at the rear of the Council Chambers.  Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
AGENCY ACTIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR - The Redevelopment Agency Consent Calendar may be acted upon with one motion, a second and the vote.
RCC 1.
Approve the Regular meeting minutes of January 22, 2008.
RCC 2.
Award Housing and Neighborhood Revitalization Department Construction Project No. 1, Expansion of the Lancaster Community Homeless Shelter, to Bowe Contractors, Inc. in the amount of $839,794.00 plus a 10% contingency, for the construction of fourteen family transitional units at the Lancaster Community Homeless Shelter.
COUNCIL ACTIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR - The City Council Consent Calendar may be acted upon with one motion, a second and the vote.
CC 1.
Waive further reading of any proposed ordinances. (This permits reading the title only in lieu of reciting the entire text.)
CC 2.
Approval of Minutes
A)
Regular Meeting Minutes of January 22, 2008
B)
Special Meeting Minutes of January 29, 2008
C)
Special Water Workshop Minutes of January 29, 2008
CC 3.
Approve the Check and Wire Registers (January 6, 2008 through January 26, 2008) in the amount of $12,204,570.36.
CC 4.
Accept and approve the December 31, 2007 Monthly Report of Investments as submitted.
CC 5.
Adopt Resolution No. 08-05 , authorizing the destruction of certain records (Plans & Plan checks, Correspondence, Recruitment Files, Worker’s Comp Claims, Grants, Travel Records, Accounts Payable).
CC 6.
Adopt Ordinance No. 896, an ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lancaster, California, adding Chapter 17.42, Alcoholic Beverage Establishments and Related Amendments to Chapters 17.12, 17.16, 17.32 and 17.40 of the Lancaster Municipal Code.
CC 7.
Adopt Ordinance No. 897, an ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lancaster, California, adding Chapter 5.18 to the Lancaster Municipal Code to implement provisions of the Digital Infrastructure and Video Competition act of 2006.
CC 8.
Adopt Resolution No. 08-06, amending the List of Designated Employment Classifications as provided in Section 2.40, Title 2, of the Lancaster Municipal Code.
CC 9
Accept the interior street trees for maintenance by the City for: Tract No. 060126, located between 46th Street West and 47th Street West, approximately 660 feet north of Avenue J-8, Owner: Lancaster Crown Ridge, G.P., and Tract No. 060450-03, located on the northwest corner of 60th Street West and Avenue K-8, Owner: Pinnacle Northwood 78, LLC.
CC 10.
Approve and accept for maintenance the work and materials for the landscape improvements for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1, Annexation No. 342, installed for: Tract No. 061680, located on the southwest corner of Avenue K and 60th Street West, Owner: KB Home Greater Los Angeles, Inc.
CC 11.
Approve the map and accept the dedications as offered on the map for Parcel Map 69972, located on the southeast corner of 10th Street West and Avenue L; make findings that this project will not violate any of the provisions of Sections 66473.5, 66474.1, and 66474.6 of the Subdivision Map Act; and instruct the City Clerk to endorse on the face of the map the certificate which embodies the approval of said map and the dedications shown thereon.
CC 12.
Accept the work constructed by Taft Electric Company for Public Works Construction Project No. 07-006 Traffic Signal Avenue I / 15th Street East; direct the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion for the project; and authorize payment of the 10 percent retention 35 days after recordation, provided no stop notices, as provided by law, have been filed.
CC 13.
Accept the work constructed by Christopher R. Morales, Inc. for Public Works Construction Project No. 07-026, Traffic Signal Modifications ; direct the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion for the project; and authorize payment of the 10 percent retention 35 days after recordation, provided no stop notices, as provided by law, have been filed.
CC 14.
Extend the Undertaking Agreement and Improvement Securities for: Tract Map No. 060428, located on the southwest corner of 40th Street West and Avenue J-6, to February 12, 2009, Developer: American Premiere Homes, Inc.
CC 15.
Extend the Undertaking Agreement and Improvement Securities for: Tract Map No. 061756, located on the south side of Avenue H-8, approximately 120 feet west of 3rd Street East, to August 12, 2008, Developer: Larwin Company.
CC 16.
Extend the Undertaking Agreement and Improvement Securities for: Tract Map No. 53102-01, located on the southwest corner of Avenue J-8 and 45th Street West, to August 12, 2008, Developer: Magnolia, LP.
CC 17.
Adopt the Tax Sharing Resolution for proposed Annexation No. 40-116 (4-181) into Los Angeles County Waterworks District No. 40, Antelope Valley.
CC 18.
Adopt Resolution No. 08-07, amending Resolution No. 06-231, establishing the classifications of Lead Utility Maintenance Worker, Development Services Project Coordinator, City Engineer, Deputy Public Works Director, Senior Engineer and Utility Services Manager.
CC 19.
Adopt Resolution No. 08-08 , authorizing the City Manager, or his designee, to apply for all funds available to the City of Lancaster, from the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority, allocated for street and road improvements for the fiscal year 2007-2008 in the amount of $5,000,795.00.
CC 20.
Annexation No. 07-46 , Parcel Map No. 061949 , located on the south side of Avenue K, approximately 660 feet west of future 105th Street West . Owner: The Rafael and Aida Torres, Sr. Living Trust, UTD, May 5, 2003, Rafael Torres, Sr. and Aida Torres, Trustees . Annexation No. 07-58 , Tract No. 067582 , located on the north side of Avenue J-8, approxiately 685 feet west of 50th Street West . Owner: Stratham Montecito West, Inc., a California Corporation .
Recommendation :
Adopt Resolution No. 08-09 , initiating proceedings for the annexation of territories to Lancaster Drainage Benefit Assessment District to be established pursuant to the Benefit Assessment Act of 1982 and California Constitution Article XIIID (Annexation Nos. 07-46, and 07-58 ).
Adopt Resolution No. 08-10 , approving the Engineer's Report and the time and place for Public Hearing, and declaring its intention to annex territories into Lancaster Drainage Benefit Assessment District and to levy and collect assessments pursuant to the Benefit Assessment Act of 1982 and California Constitution Article XIIID (Annexation Nos. 07-46, and 07-58 ).
CC 21.
Proposed Annexations to Lancaster Lighting Maintenance District
Annexation No. 825, Parcel Map No. 061949, located on the south side of Avenue K, approximately 660 feet west of future 105th Street West. Owner: The Rafael and Aida Torres, Sr. Living Trust, UTD, May 5, 2003, Rafael Torres, Sr. and Aida Torres, Trustees.
Annexation No. 838, Tract No. 067582, located on the north side of Avenue J-8, approxiately 685 feet west of 50th Street West. Owner: Stratham Montecito West, Inc., a California Corporation.
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 08-11, initiating proceedings for the annexation of territories into Lancaster Lighting Maintenance District, an Assessment district established pursuant to the Landscaping and Lighting Act of 1972 and California Constitution Article XIIID (Annexation Nos. 825 and 838);
Adopt Resolution No. 08-12, approving the Engineer's Report and the time and place for Public Hearing, and declaring its intention to annex territories into Lancaster Lighting Maintenance District and to levy and collect assessments pursuant to Part 2 of Division 15 of the Streets and Highways Code of the State of California and California Constitution Article XIIID (Annexation Nos. 825 and 838).
CC 22.
Annexation No. 404 , Parcel Map No. 061949 , located on the south side of Avenue K, approximately 660 feet west of future 105th Street West . Owner: The Rafael and Aida Torres, Sr. Living Trust, UTD, May 5, 2003, Rafael Torres, Sr. and Aida Torres, Trustees . Annexation No. 405 , Tract No. 067582 , located on the north side of Avenue J-8, approxiately 685 feet west of 50th Street West . Owner: Stratham Montecito West, Inc., a California Corporation .
Recommendation :
Adopt Resolution No. 08-13 , initiating proceedings for the annexation of territories into Lancaster Landscape Maintenance District No. 1, an Assessment District established pursuant to the Landscaping and Lighting Act of 1972 and California Constitution Article XIIID (Annexation Nos. 404 and 405 ).
Adopt Resolution No. 08-14 , approving the Engineer's Report and the time and place for Public Hearing, and declaring its intention to annex territories into Lancaster Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 and to levy and collect assessments pursuant to Part 2 of Division 15 of the Streets and Highways Code of the State of California and California Constitution Article XIIID (Annexation Nos. 404 and 405 ).

PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR - NON-AGENDIZED ITEMS
This portion of the agenda allows an individual the opportunity to address the City Council / Redevelopment Agency on any item NOT ON THE AGENDA regarding City / Agency business. Please complete a speaker card for the City Clerk / Agency Secretary and identify the subject you would like to address. State law prohibits the City Council / Redevelopment Agency from taking action on items not on the agenda. Your matter will be referred to the City Manager / Executive Director. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
COUNCIL / AGENCY COMMENTS
CLOSED SESSION
ADJOURNMENT (Agency and Council)
Next Regular Meeting:
Tuesday, February 26, 2008, 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, this meeting will be held at a location accessible to persons with disabilities; if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (661)723-6020. Services such as American Sign Language interpreters, a reader during the meeting, and/or large print copies of the agenda are available. To ensure availability, you are advised to make your request at least 72 hours prior to the meeting/event you wish to attend. Due to difficulties in securing sign language interpreters, five or more business days notice is strongly recommended. For additional information, please contact the City Clerk at (661)723-6020.
